blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — D.M. Wenceslao and Associates Inc. (DMW), the developer of Aseana City, said its net income declined by 11 percent on weaker property sales and higher operating expenses. The company reported that its net profit attributable to the parent fell to P1.24 billion from P1.4 billion a year ago. READ: DM Wenceslao posts lower Q1 profit amid tougher property market The property developer’s consolidated revenues dropped by 6.9 percent to P2.68 billion from P2.88 billion. This was because revenue from the sale of residential units slipped 58 percent to P162.2 million from P387.3 million due to lower contribution from Midpark Towers […]...
